Hi Marissa —

Thanks — appreciate the options. Quick heads up: our procurement/security team requires completion of a vendor security questionnaire and an executed NDA before we allow external vendor demos with product screenshots or shared infra details. It’s a new gating step this quarter.

Tentative timeline on our side:
- We can review and sign an NDA by EOD Mon Feb 21 if you send it over via DocuSign.
- We’d need to complete the vendor onboarding questionnaire by Tue Feb 22 (our security team will send it back with any questions).

Can we hold off on the demo until those items are complete? If so, can you provisionally hold Thu Feb 24 at 10:00am PT for a 45-minute slot? We’ll confirm once paperwork is done.

For reference, I’ve looped in Tom from procurement.

Thanks,
